description: Reported on the controller / Steam Deck: step 1 of Musterin' da Boyz told a pad player to 'glide {ls} onto da Warboss dropdown' even though the Battle Formations dialog is an ordinary focus chain the D-pad already walks - and the same left-stick-first wording ran through the other lessons. The pad prompts now lead with the D-pad wherever the D-pad can actually get there, so this scenario drives the whole opening of T2 with the D-pad and A ONLY: there is no pad_cursor_glide anywhere in the run. It also pins the dialog-focus half of the fix - the tutorial's injected 'Exit Tutorial' button is no longer the pad's auto-focus pick, so A on the roll-off dialog rolls the dice instead of opening the leave-the-tutorial confirm, which is what a player following the step actually got.

steps.comment: retire the first-launch nudge so this scenario also runs standalone on a pristine profile
LB claims pad mode - every prompt below is the 'pad' variant
THE FIX: the step's pad prompt names the D-pad and no longer sends the player hunting with the left stick
the dialog hands the pad a focus to walk from - which is what makes the D-pad route real
D-pad up walks the dialog's focus chain to its top row - the 'Warboss ->' leader dropdown (it clamps there, so extra taps are harmless)
the D-pad really lands on the leader-attachment dropdown - no cursor involved
D-pad down walks the popup onto 'Boyz (10 models)'
Warboss -> Boyz, attached with the D-pad alone
back down to the TRANSPORT EMBARKATION tickboxes - Warlord, Warboss, then Boyz
down past the last tickbox lands on Skip, exactly as the step says (the chain clamps there, so extra taps are harmless)
and right swaps onto Confirm Formations

THE SECOND FIX: the tutorial's injected Exit Tutorial button used to win the pad's auto-focus here, so the step's 'press A on da dialog's Roll button' opened the leave-the-tutorial confirm instead. It is a last-resort target now.
and the post-roll refocus never falls back onto Exit Tutorial either - that is how the second A used to boot the player out
no leave-the-tutorial confirm was ever raised during this run
the whole opening of the lesson, D-pad and A only - no glide anywhere in this scenario
every lesson file still validates after the prompt rewrite
